## Pull Request Checklist

### Linkage
- [ ] Linked Issue: `Fixes #<number>`
- [ ] Owner label (`agent:*`) is present on linked Issue
- [ ] Status label moved to `status:needs-review`

### Evidence
- [ ] Test evidence included (commands + result)
- [ ] Screenshots or logs attached for UI/ops changes
- [ ] Acceptance criteria from the Issue are satisfied

### Risk and Recovery
- [ ] Risk summary added
- [ ] Rollback plan added
- [ ] Monitoring plan added

### Staging Verification
- [ ] Verified in staging (`https://www.terapixel.games/staging/` when applicable)
- [ ] Staging verification notes included

## Required PR Body Fields
- Issue:
- Scope:
- Test Evidence:
- Risk:
- Rollback:
- Staging Verification:
